title: Xdrip With Miao Miao 2
body:
Quick question - Will Miao Miao 2 work with Xdrip using Libre 1?

Many thanks.

comments.body: This already works with the latest xdrip.
Okay thanks will order the Miao Miao 2
I am just wondering is it worth buy miaomiao 2 ? I have version 1 today... what is the big difference ?

> I am just wondering is it worth buy miaomiao 2 ? I have version 1 today... what is the big difference ?

If your mm1 is still working fine there's barely any difference. I have both no need to upgrade in my opinion.
I have bought it anyway i hope for better stability for the bluetooth delivery :-)
You need to download the latest xDRIP, not the stable you have to stay on the master branch.
I have tried, but nothing @razerrazer
Mine is detecting a Bluetooth device but not connecting. It has been stuck on data collector running. I have tried different versions of xdrip and still have the same problem

Same for me. I've tried stable and alpha versions and like gemmid81 I can connect to the miaomiao2 but I get no readings. 
With the Tomato app it works, and I can scan using the Libre reader so no problem with the libre sensor itself. 

I have "Libre bluetooth" set as Hardware Data Source.
I have also tried to uninstall the Tomato app but still no data is being sent. 

Edit: 
After selecting alpha version (and restarting), I could choose the nightly build which actually gave me some readings.

If you are on the latest binaries, can you please let me know if you see the following message on the logs?
"Got null pointer trying to set CCCD descriptor"
To see the logs, please go to the three points on the right and choose: "view events log"
If there is a different message, please post it here.

Indeed.
DexCollectionService
"Got null pointer trying to set CCCD descriptor"
Also "Error receiving too much data" and "NonMonotonicSequenceException" after the nullpointer if that is of any use.

I only got two readings when I replied here earlier, haven't gotten any readings since.

Thanks for the info.
Did the same phone work with MM1?

Can you please try with this version:
https://drive.google.com/uc?id=18GTYzBp0rDVspy1bopaagyN6UrZDZJpc&export=download

Please note that you will have to uninstall and install the new version.
you can backup your settings and db before.

The same phone worked great with MM1.

I tried the version you linked and it does seem to work. It shows 5 data points and requested calibration directly. I can return in an hour or two to see if anything has changed.
Even with that xDrip+, the app is not detecting my MM2, although with Tomato's app, it does.

Hi @tzachi-dar

The build you posted worked for me. :)

I also had the exact same problem of a working MM1 and changed to a MM2 (same phone) and it would connect fine but receive no readings.

Anyway, thanks!

@digitalemil I have missed the part that you are using libre2 sensors.

In this case you have two options:
1) Use the patched librelink application.
2) Use an experimental build that I have created (still at very early stages of debug).

If you want option #2, send me a mail to tzachi.dar@gamil.com
This version is working with miaomiao2 but the Nightscout synch couldn t be enabled.

Please update to latest xdrip version for the work with MM2.
https://github.com/NightscoutFoundation/xDrip/releases/download/2019.11.22/xDrip-plus-20191122-b7bc355.apk

If you are getting the error: "Got null pointer trying to set CCCD
descriptor"
Please go to settings->less common settings-> extra logging settings->extra
tags for logging
And add there:
DexcollectionService:v

Estoy usando Libre2 con miao miao2 y el algoritmo OOP funcionando en segundo plano. La versión xdrip que tengo instalada es xDrip-plus-20191122-b7bc355.apk.  No me permite habilitar Nightscout, y lo que es peor, NO SE AJUSTAN LAS CALIBRACIONES. ¿Tiene solución? ¿le ocurre a alguien mas?

Me pasó a mí también y, en mi opinión, Libre 2 + MM2 es horrible, respecto a las calibraciones. Aún no he probado en profundidad la app parcheada de LibreLink junto a xDrip+, pero creo que será la mejor opción.

As for not having nightscout, you can update to the latest version and this has nightscout support.
As for calibrations on libre 2:
We now have the possibility to calibrate libre 2 (using mm/blucon/bubble).
Should also work on android 10.
If anyone is interested to test this, please write here.
